quotes.author: luvstotravel30, Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Captain Randy took my family and friends for a great afternoon ride. We did tubing, saw dolphins, explored two small island beaches, crabbed, and fished. He was very knowledgeable of the sights in the ICW and attentive to making the experience fun for all! We came away with 40+ blue crabs, which made a great meal to top off the day. Highly recommend Capt. Randy for a fun-filled day!

quotes.author: AWRVA, Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Captain Randy took us on the best adventure. We've been coming to the OBX for 30+ years and saw things we've never seen. We saw dolphins, and osprey nests, a hermit crab island, caught fish, went tubing, and brought up a few crab pots. It was an excellent morning. Worth every penny. We also loved the cruise through the fishing marina in Wanchese. Loved hearing all the stories.

quotes.author: Jackson L, Tripadvisor
quotes.text: I went with a group of 6 and at no time was I bored. We went fishing, tubing, crabbing, island hoping, dolphin watching and clamming. He told us all about the big ships we passed and he seemed to know everybody else out on the water. All in all it was a really great way to start the day, would recommend!

quotes.author: Dfaust, Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Captain Randy was great! We went out on the tubes, we saw dolphins and we even learned first hand how to bring in crabs! We have 4 kids, ranging from 12 to 23 years and fun was had by all. On the way home, all 4 kiddos said this was the best adventure we have done in all our years visiting the OBX!
